profile.headline: Director Quality Assurance
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer - Quality Assurance/ Automation/ Dev Ops and Server Admin

positions.title: Sr. QA Engineer
positions.description:
Software Quality Assurance - Testing ExtJS web applications and supporting tools.

Software Quality Assurance Management - Directed/ Grew QA teams working in Czech Republic. Leveled up test areas and metrics reporting to Sencha Executive staff. 

DevOps - Release Engineering/ Managing Continuous Integration systems across all products. Responsible for pushing releases to public and private repositories. Maintaining build agent systems for all products.

positions.title: Sr. QA Engineer
positions.description:
Performance Test Engineer – Manage and execute a python based automation performance framework for edge broadband application NBBS Edge. Track defects, create/execute testing based on customer requirements. Server administration. 

Lead QA Engineer – Coordinate with software engineers to plan and execute testing on a Java based web browser site editor eSiteNXG. Testing across multiple platforms and browsers. Server Administration.

positions.title: Support Service Manager
positions.description:
Technical Customer Support Manager – Manage customer support department. Diagnosis hardware/software failure and work with engineering to resolve. 

Lead QA Engineer – Coordinate testing standards/procedures, Implementation, Debugging (hardware/software).

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Western Regional SQA – Coordinate testing standards/procedures, Implementation, Debugging (hardware/software). Manage project deadlines and software analysis with both Gtech and the Kansas Lottery. Evaluate all new and current system software for online gaming in Kansas, New Mexico, Arizona, and Missouri.
